articles.title: Keep a visitor book at the farm gate
articles.summary: Write down who came, when, and where they had been before.
articles.body:
A visitor book helps you trace where a problem may have come from.

- Ask every visitor to write their name, phone number and the date.
- Ask whether they visited another farm that day.
- Keep footwear cleaning at the entrance.
